## Type of change

<!-- Mark every relevant option with an "x". -->

- [ ] Documentation or community files
- [ ] Build, tooling, CI, or release infrastructure
- [ ] CLI behavior
- [ ] Planning, discovery, preset, or execution logic
- [ ] Tests or fixtures
- [ ] Breaking change

## Validation

<!-- List the checks actually run. Prefer targeted checks for the changed area. -->

- [ ] `make check`
- [ ] Relevant targeted tests or docs review

## Risk and rollout

<!--
Call out compatibility impact, migration notes, operational risk, or why there
is no user-visible risk.
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR is focused on one reviewable step.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior, workflow, or contributor guidance changes.
- [ ] New dependencies are justified and committed with lockfile updates.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior avoids shell execution, secrets in logs, and unbounded input/output.
- [ ] Follow-up work is described in review context instead of bundled into this PR.
